item.description:
VIDEO | Union MoS for Health and Family Welfare Prataprao Jadhav (@mpprataprao) says, "Everyone needs money, and we all work to earn it. However, more important than the money or wealth we need in our lives is the need to maintain good health. If we remain healthy, we will be able to make good use of the money we earn. But if our health is poor, no matter how much money we have, we will not be able to enjoy or make proper use of it. That is why, to maintain good health, Dhanvantari, who is regarded as the deity of health, should be worshipped in every household and institution on the occasion of Dhanteras. As the saying goes, people spend their entire lives earning money, only to spend that same money in the final years of their lives trying to preserve their health. Therefore, I believe we should take care of our health while continuing to earn money. We will certainly be able to earn wealth, and people will also be able to contribute to the progress of our country. That is why Dhanteras holds great significance for all of us, and we should celebrate it with tremendous enthusiasm.”

#Dhanteras

item.title: 🇧🇷 🚨 THE GENTLEMEN RANSOMWARE CLAIMS MATO GROSSO STATE HEALTH DEPARTMENT The Gentlemen ransomware group has listed the Secretaria de Estado d...
item.description:
🇧🇷 🚨 THE GENTLEMEN RANSOMWARE CLAIMS MATO GROSSO STATE HEALTH DEPARTMENT

The Gentlemen ransomware group has listed the Secretaria de Estado de Saúde de Mato Grosso (SES-MT), the state health department of Mato Grosso, Brazil, on its leak site.

SES-MT runs public healthcare for 141 municipalities and about 3.6 million residents, including state hospitals, laboratories, blood centers and a free medication program.

The listing appeared on Nov 2, 2026. The group has not published a data volume or described what it took, and SES-MT has not commented on this claim so far.

This is the department's second reported ransomware incident this year. SES-MT confirmed a cyberattack in March 2026, which local reporting tied to LockBit, and said the affected data was recovered and no ransom was paid.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
State health systems hold patient, lab and procurement records that are prime extortion leverage. A repeat listing within months points to either a new intrusion or lingering access. This is an unverified ransomware claim; no new breach has been confirmed.

item.description:
STORY | Don't travel by air, says SC; refuses urgent listing of plea alleging 700 pc hike in airfares

Don't travel by air, the Supreme Court told a petitioner on Monday while refusing urgent listing of a plea alleging nearly 700 per cent increase in airfares.

An advocate mentioned the matter for urgent listing before a bench comprising Justices Vikram Nath, Sandeep Mehta and Aparesh Kumar Singh.

"The aviation fare has increased by 700 per cent," the advocate said.

"Don't travel by air," the bench observed.

The advocate then said air travel is an essential service. "It's a violation of Article 14."

Article 14 of the Constitution deals with equality before law.

The apex court is already hearing a separate petition filed by social activist S Laxminarayanan, who has sought a robust and independent regulator that ensures transparency and passenger protection across the civil aviation sector and regulatory guidelines to control "unpredictable fluctuations" in airfare and ancillary charges imposed by private airlines in India.

During a hearing on that plea on October 16, the Centre informed the top court that administrative approval has been granted to rules under a 2024 legislation aimed at regulating India's aviation sector, and is likely to be published in two weeks.

The apex court had asked Solicitor General Tushar Mehta to place the published rules under the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024, before the court on the next date of hearing -- November 16.

READ: https://www.ptinews.com/story/national/don-t-travel-by-air-says-sc;-refuses-urgent-listing-of-plea-alleging-700-pc-hike-in-airfares=/4223692

item.description:
🇺🇸 🚨 UNITED RENTALS: THREAT ACTOR CLAIMS SALE OF 777,000 USER RECORDS

A threat actor on a dark web forum is selling what they claim are about 777,000 user records belonging to United Rentals, the largest equipment rental company in North America. The asking price is $1,000.

The actor claims the data includes:
• Email addresses (personal and corporate, per the posted sample)
• User account records

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The only proof offered is a sample of email addresses, so the depth of the data is unclear. If genuine, the corporate addresses give attackers a ready target list for phishing and business email compromise posing as rental invoices or account notices. Customers should be wary of unexpected billing emails and reset passwords. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

🇺🇸 🚨 RIOT GAMES: THREAT ACTOR CLAIMS 84,000 CUSTOMER RECORDS WITH PURCHASE HISTORY

A threat actor on a dark web forum claims to have a database of about 84,000 records tied to customers of Riot Games, the studio behind League of Legends and Valorant. The actor says the records span 2024 to 2026.

The actor claims the data includes:
• Account details and full names
• Country and contact information
• Purchase history
• Transaction details

⚠️ Analyst Note:
No sample has been independently checked and Riot Games has not commented. If genuine, purchase and transaction data makes convincing lures for phishing and payment fraud aimed at players. Players should watch for fake "billing problem" or account-ban emails, and turn on MFA. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

item.description:
🇨🇦 🚨 HOSTWINDS GROUP: THREAT ACTOR CLAIMS SALE OF 3.75 MILLION HOSTING CUSTOMER RECORDS

A threat actor on a dark web forum is selling what they claim is about 3.75 million records stolen from a Canadian hosting group whose brands include Hostwinds, Hostopia, ColoCloud, ChicagoVPS, HudsonValleyHost and Managed[.]com. The asking price is $4,000.

The actor claims the data includes:
• About 793K billing-system client records (names, emails, locations, phone numbers)
• About 1.29M email mailbox accounts
• About 1.07M Hostopia control panel accounts
• About 592K domain-to-mail-server mappings, plus hosting and domain tables

⚠️ Analyst Note:
This lands days after Hostwinds disclosed unauthorized access to its client area and billing system on Oct 22. If genuine, the data is ready-made for phishing posing as hosting or domain renewal notices, business email compromise and takeover of hosting accounts. Customers of these brands should reset passwords and turn on MFA. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

#DDW #DarkWeb #Hostwinds #WebHosting #DataLeak #ThreatIntelligence

item.description:
🇵🇱 🚨 POLAND: THREAT ACTOR ADVERTISES DATA ALLEGEDLY FROM THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE

A threat actor on a dark web forum is advertising data it says comes from Poland's Ministry of Justice (Ministerstwo Sprawiedliwości).

According to the post and its sample:
* Usernames and hashed passwords (MD5-style)
* Full names, email addresses and phone numbers
* City and last-login IP addresses
* Sold privately via a marketplace sellers' section, no record count given

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The listing gives no volume and comes from a low-reputation account, so it may be recycled or mislabelled portal data. If genuine, ministry staff and justice-system contact data would be valuable for spear-phishing against Polish government and judicial targets. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.
